scope: Read-only 64 completed rows, original RAW caches, saved pair classifications, and exact output/indexed arrays. No geometry scoring/model calls.
notes: Parent means average registered noises first; all 8 parents equally weighted. ALL uses 4 fixed noises per parent.
S and E higher is better; I and distances/intersection affected fractions lower is better. Point values and conservative bounds are reported separately.
CF/FF completion means numerical static scan; unresolved or degenerate pairs remain explicit and never certify no intersection/watertightness.
Affected free fractions use actual N_after-K; pair counts alone are not normalized across removed faces.
F-to-GT uses original seed and original area-sampling algorithm remapped to the modified free surface, not old Q_F coordinates.
GEO_C has no new trajectory; C_all_steps and initial noise are NA there, while actual C prefix/export checks are separate.
